messages.author: b453c29749de564d
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] flat prior on the standard deviation
parts:
On Thu, 2013-02-07 at 22:32 -0800, Laina Mercer wrote:
> Hi, when I run the example from the flat prior tutorial I get the
> following error. I'm having the same problem when I try to use the
> flat prior in the f(<whatever>,prior="flat") context.
>
>
> > n=100
> > z=rnorm(n)
> > y=rnorm(n,z,1)
> > data=list(y=y,z=z)
> > formula=y~1+z
> >
> result=inla(formula,family="gaussian",data=data,control.family=list(prior="flat"))

if you set prior="flat" then the default values for 'param' does not
change, hence since 'flat' has no parameter they need to be set as well
to 'no parmamters', so

prior = "flat", param = numeric(0)

is the way to do this. I know, it's not obvious at all!

H
